# Request file for .github/workflows/fetch-refs.yml.
#
# Change this file and push, and the workflow runs with these values on a
# GitHub runner (which can reach Wikimedia Commons). browse and resolve
# only print to the run's log. fetch downloads into references/jewish/,
# appends SOURCES.md, and commits the images back to this branch.
#
# mode:  browse | resolve | fetch
# items: semicolon-separated — categories (browse), File: titles (resolve),
#        or slot=File:Title pairs (fetch; slots in tools/fetch_jewish_refs.py)
# force: true to let fetch replace a file that already exists

request: 1
mode: browse
items: Category:Sukkah; Category:Etrog; Category:Torah scrolls (open); Category:Torah scrolls (individual images); Category:Torah pointers; Category:Torah arks; Category:Hakafot; Category:Simchat Torah
force: false
